response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full stack experience (15+ years) spanning TypeScript/Node.js, React/Ember, MongoDB, SQL, Docker, and cloud/Kubernetes deployments, well exceeding the 6+ years requirement. His current role explicitly involves TypeScript/Node.js product work plus AI-agent infrastructure (MCP frameworks), directly matching the primary stack and the AI agent development requirement. He lacks explicit Nest.js and Vitest mentions and Kotlin experience, but his breadth across many languages (DLang, Java, C#, Swift) and platforms suggests strong adaptability to fill these gaps quickly.
